examples.title: Finding Factors
examples.explanation: 20 ÷ 1 = 20, 20 ÷ 2 = 10, 20 ÷ 4 = 5. These numbers divide 20 without a remainder.

examples.title: L.C.M. of 4 and 6
examples.problem: Find the Lowest Common Multiple (L.C.M) of 4 and 6.
examples.solution: Multiples of 4: 4, 8, 12, 16... Multiples of 6: 6, 12, 18... Smallest common is 12.
examples.explanation: L.C.M is the smallest number that is a multiple of both numbers.

examples.title: H.C.F. of 15 and 25
examples.problem: Find the Highest Common Factor (H.C.F) of 15 and 25.
examples.solution: Factors of 15: 1, 3, 5, 15. Factors of 25: 1, 5, 25. Common factors: 1, 5. Highest is 5.
examples.explanation: H.C.F is the largest number that divides both numbers exactly.
